public_contract.identity: ShaderProgram identity, ParameterValues, native session, ShaderPlayback and Long inputRevision remain separate; accepted ShaderDefinition/ParameterSchema reused
public_contract.clock: rememberShaderPlayback owns a single frame loop; shared returned state feeds multiple modifiers. Initial values read once. Pause/seek/speed/suspension preserve last sampled phase and rebase next frame with no catch-up. Position finite signed Double, overflow saturates MAX; render conversion outside finite Float range reports error. Speed finite >=0, negative/nonfinite reject, zero settles. No automatic persistence.
public_contract.lifecycle: Host explicitly supplies active=true, reducedMotion=false, modifier visible=true defaults. Inactive/reduced freezes automatic timeline; seek/live revisions still render. Hidden skips provider refresh and retains filter; suspend shared driver when all consumers hidden. Removal cancels driver and closes owned sessions; caller factory remains caller-owned.
public_contract.revision: Retain provider; publish complete snapshot then increment inputRevision. Paused unchanged path schedules no continuous work. Validated declared finite scalar/image results reused; images borrowed without concurrent mutation, colors structural. Failure retry while paused requires changed key/revision.
public_contract.sessions: ControlledSessionOwner uses accepted transactional DefinitionShaderSession for defined value/source/size/provider changes, and transactional native replacement for legacy config/size and factory changes. Failed replacement preserves last native filter and external timeline.
public_contract.legacy: No old declarations or timing changes; shaderEffect/animate=false/frameDataKey remain. Controlled path exclusively uses supplied playback over effect time/isAnimating.
public_contract.invalidation: Retained bounded microscopic rotation; no unverified replacement introduced.
